resources.string: Runs 2 seconds after the page loads. Example: alert(\'Hello from JavaScript!\');
On: the page fills the whole screen and draws behind the system bars. The page handles its own safe-area padding via env(safe-area-inset-*). Needs WebView M136+.
Leave empty to use the real system inset. Enter 0 to force none. Pixels, not clamped. Needs Android 11+ (API 30).
Forces env(safe-area-inset-*) for the page. Blank uses the real system inset; 0 forces none. Pixels, not clamped. Needs Android 11+ (API 30).
Use Default Cache (Use default cache behavior)
